articles.title: Cats, dogs and horses: Rescuing the pets caught in France’s wildfires
articles.description: Wildfires raging through southwestern France have forced thousands to evacuate their homes in the fire-ravaged department of Gironde. Many of the evacuees were forced to leave their pets behind amid the ensuing chaos. articles.description: The Islamic Republic publicly executed two Iranian protesters in Isfahan at dawn on July 28. articles.title: How volunteers are helping forest wildlife survive their blazing habitats
articles.description: Humans are not the only victims of the massive wildfires that have ravaged France over recent weeks. Heartrending images of deer and other wildlife fleeing flames, disoriented and distressed, have propagated across social media in recent days. Less visible species - smaller mammals and insects whose populations are critical to fragile ecosystems - have also been decimated. Groups of volunteers have been combing affected areas, searching for survivors to rehabilitate.
